basis: The chart titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' (r2.O1) provides the consumption shares for each category: Nuclear (45%), Hydroelectric (30%), Fossil Fuels (15%), and Renewables (10%). Comparing these labeled values, Nuclear at 45% is the largest category. The routing criterion 'Largest global energy consumption category' therefore identifies Nuclear as the source to route to priority monitoring. The option 'Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring' corresponds to this category.
option_label: Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring
